props.name: status

props.description: An object that represents the status of ingress on an environment.
props.name: ingress

props.description: This string represents the state of ingress operations on an environment. It can be "Disabled", "Ready", "Running", "Paused" or "Unknown"
props.name: state

props.description: An object that contains the details about an environment's state.
props.name: stateDetails

props.description: An object that contains the details about warm storage properties usage state.
props.name: stateDetails

props.description: A value that represents the number of properties used by the environment for S1/S2 SKU and number of properties used by Warm Store for PAYG SKU
props.name: currentCount

props.description: A value that represents the maximum number of properties used allowed by the environment for S1/S2 SKU and maximum number of properties allowed by Warm Store for PAYG SKU.
props.name: maxCount

props.description: The behavior the Time Series Insights service should take when the environment's capacity has been exceeded. If "PauseIngress" is specified, new events will not be read from the event source. If "PurgeOldData" is specified, new events will continue to be read and old events will be deleted from the environment. The default behavior is PurgeOldData.
props.name: storageLimitExceededBehavior

props.name: storageConfiguration
